proposed_rules.title: Unavailable-state contract
proposed_rules.rule: Specify why unavailable, recovery action, tab discoverability, and activation prevention separately. Choose native disabled or aria-disabled with guarded action from that contract.
proposed_rules.exception: Native disabled is valid when removal from sequential focus is intentional and explanation remains available. Do not mandate aria-disabled everywhere.
proposed_rules.falsifier: A focusable aria-disabled button still invokes its action via Enter/Space/pointer; or the only recovery explanation cannot be reached without a mouse.

proposed_rules.title: Initial-focus decision and one owner
proposed_rules.rule: Record task-specific initial target and assign exactly one component responsibility for open-time focus; use trap only for containment if modal owns initial focus.
proposed_rules.exception: Structured/long content can need static heading focus; destructive confirmation can need least-destructive action; action-only confirmation may use its primary action.
proposed_rules.falsifier: Opening moves focus twice, repeats the title in target AT, scrolls the introduction away, or defaults to irreversible action without an explicit choice.

proposed_rules.title: Modal exit cleanup independent of focus restoration
proposed_rules.rule: On every actual close path restore page interaction/AT exposure independently of opener lookup, then restore focus to a surviving logical target.
proposed_rules.exception: With another active modal, restore according to active modal stack rather than globally enabling background.
proposed_rules.falsifier: Remove invoking element while open, close by button and Escape, and find leaked aria-hidden/inert or keyboard focus lost without a planned fallback.

proposed_rules.title: Changing-content focus fallback
proposed_rules.rule: When focused dialog content is replaced, preserve containment using a documented focusable fallback even if no tabbable child exists.
proposed_rules.exception: Do not copy a library's dialog-wrapper fallback as a universal initial-focus rule; choose semantics and target-AT behavior.
proposed_rules.falsifier: Replace all controls with a status panel and observe activeElement becoming document.body or background content reachable.

proposed_rules.title: Native semantic choice and library capability ownership
proposed_rules.rule: Choose semantic element by action versus navigation and explicit button type. For library/custom components list which layer owns keyboard activation, focus entry, containment, and restoration.
proposed_rules.exception: Do not infer that native button evidence proves universal native dialog compatibility. Existing design-system components can own behavior if verified in integration.
proposed_rules.falsifier: A non-submit button submits its surrounding form; a styled anchor uses a disabled attribute with no guard; a library and wrapper both claim initial-focus ownership.
